title: docs(pm-dispatch): revoke every autonomous-adjudication channel — a seat analyses and recommends, every needs_decision goes to the maintainer's ruling batch
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DKgg3KvTdrTtgi5LFfUa7Ss)_

Fixes #25344

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:把 pm-dispatch 技能里所有「Claude 可以自己裁」的通道全部撤掉——项目内裁决线程、「有把握自己决定」常设令、分诊代裁车道与置信门四条、`auto-adjudicated` 标记、总监席「一类自裁」免呈、PM 对 dev `needs_decision` 的直接答复。改后一句话:席位只分析与推荐,每个 `needs_decision` 都并入决裁批次,由您人工裁。
- **为什么改**:您 2026-10-23 的原话:「我记得有一个skills 允许自主决裁，撤销这个决定。必须人工决裁。」
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:决裁批次会多出以前「有把握就自裁」的那部分卡,批次变长;除此之外无行为面变化,纯文本改动,一次 revert 可回。
- **席位意见**:(席位复核后填)
- **你要做的(一个动作)**:批 #3 您已「同意」,三项都已写入;席位复审 PASS 后,一句「可以落地」。

## What changed

Every channel in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` that let a seat, a ruling thread or the director seat rule in the maintainer's place is removed, and the text that cited it is re-pointed. A seat analyses, recommends and files; the maintainer rules.

| File | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `references/lanes/director.md` | 项目内代裁通道: a card thread's `needs_decision` ⇒ the coordinator opens a ruling thread that rules for the director seat; the standing order 「对于自己有把握决定的问题，自己决定」; 「有把握」= the four-condition confidence gate; the `needs_decision fork` record form and the coordinator's 追认表 | `needs_decision` ⇒ the seat writes the four-axis analysis and a recommendation and the card joins the ruling batch the maintainer rules by hand; the standing order is recorded as revoked; no ruling thread, no delegated ruling, no confidence gate |
| `references/lanes/director.md` 职责二 | 一类自裁按批过 / 全立者录裁转工作态、只入追认表,不呈批 / 消费面对齐协议 ⇒ 一类自裁 / 协议有误即裁改动 | every card is presented; the seat records only the maintainer's word; protocol alignment and protocol errors are recommended and presented, never self-ruled |
| `references/lanes/director.md` L16 | 未回字 = 停,唯一例外是项目内代裁通道 | no exception |
| `references/triage-duties.md` | 代裁车道 (refactors and bug fixes), 代裁人工地板, 置信门四条, 代裁动作 + `auto-adjudicated`, 一类自裁门 (three criteria, summary table for 追认) | rulings belong to the maintainer; triage analyses, recommends and files into `needs-user-decision`; the 人工地板 list itself stays, re-homed as 「人工地板(恒呈维护者)」 so its six pointers and 例外一/例外二 keep their anchor (contract-review F1 at head 337ba767); the 机械边界测试 is kept only as the clause-② criterion (`execution-duties.md` points at it); the round report carries a 呈裁清单 instead of a 代裁清单; the 回翻条款 is kept |
| `references/dispatch-runbook.md` L146 | 终报 `needs_decision` ⇒ 席位交 coordinator 开 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 裁决线程 | 终报 `needs_decision` ⇒ 四维分析与推荐并入决裁批次呈维护者裁;⛔ 无裁决线程 |
| `SKILL.md` 红线 L30 / state table L106 | 唯一例外是已裁的代裁通道 / 除代裁通道外永不代答 | ⛔ 无代裁通道;席位只分析与推荐 / 永不代答,只由人工裁 |
| `SKILL.md` 升级与决策 L215, L219, L220, L234, L264, L267, L276 | PM 裁量含「裁定」; dev's `needs_decision` in the non-escalation class answered by the PM; the premise-bound ruling tier is the PM's; 代裁 inputs/faces; 总监席是唯一裁决者 | PM discretion is dispatch and ordering; every dev `needs_decision` goes to the human with the PM's analysis and recommendation (including "looks like a non-escalation class"); the premise-bound ruling is also the human's; the four facets are the input to the human ruling; the director seat is the only presenting seat |
| `references/seat-lifecycle.md` L69, `references/contract-review.md` L35, `references/execution-duties.md` L103 | cite the 代裁清单 / 代裁 boundary test | cite the 呈裁清单 / the triage boundary test |
| `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` | ceilings `director.md` 72, `triage-duties.md` 120 | `director.md` lowered to 70; `triage-duties.md` back at 120 after the batch-#3 text (landed counts, headroom 0); no other row moves |

Already forbidding self-ruling and untouched: `lanes/skills.md` L21, `lanes/hotcrm.md` L51/L53, `lanes/services.md` L12. No script reads `auto-adjudicated` or the revoked vocabulary (`git grep` over `scripts/`, `.github/`), so the change is text-only.

## 批 #3 已裁 (maintainer 「同意」 = 1.1 A · 1.2 A · 2 A, 2026-10-23)

The two implementation-level self-choice lines first left for the maintainer's word, plus the report-only valve and the human floor, are now written as ruled (third commit):

1. **1.1 A — keep with a guard.** A dev's implementation choices stay its own and are recorded in `open_questions`; touching product-visible behaviour or a contract is a fork, never a choice (`dispatch-runbook.md` L115). The PM's non-escalation classes carry the same guard (`SKILL.md` 〈升级与决策〉).
2. **1.2 A — keep the valve, three hard conditions.** A gate red twice in an hour on untouched packages may be flipped to report-only by any seat — only report-only (never a deleted gate or a skipped test), the item goes to the decision digest for the next batch in the same stroke with both red runs, and it flips back if the maintainer disagrees (`triage-duties.md` 例外二).
3. **2 A — the human floor, widened and judgeable.** Beside the restored list: releases and anything public, external commitments, a card's fate (not planned, downgrade, withdrawal, halving), rules and process, defaults and factory shape, identity and tenancy model, cross-lane conflicts. Two criteria, any one of which presents the item: seven risk tests (security/permission/identity/tenancy boundary; irreversible stored data; contract or ADR change; outward-visible action; gate weakening or any exemption; contrary to a ruling or a new standing order; silent on a wrong pick) and four workload tests (a size/l option or ≥2 packages; chosen plan ≥2× the cheapest viable; a new permanent maintenance surface; ≥3 serial cards or a slot held over a working day). The never-presented list and its four-gate boundary (no product-visible change, no contract change, revertible, gate-backed) close it; every presented card names the criterion it hits. `SKILL.md` gains the one pointer line that binds every seat to it.

Line budget: `triage-duties.md` lands at 120, its ceiling on `main` (−13 revocation, +13 ruling); `SKILL.md` lands at its 319 ceiling (the pointer line spends the last line of headroom); no ceiling is raised.

## Serial constraints

Open PRs on the same tree, checked before the first push: #25247 (`SKILL.md` 〈域车道〉 lane table + lane files), #25254 (`platform-readings.md` L403), #25255 (new `coordinator.md`, `SKILL.md` 入口与角色 row and the deletion of the 项目总监席 line at L274, `dispatch-runbook.md` cap line, ratchet rows beside `seat-lifecycle.md`). This PR touches none of those regions, but two hunks sit within three lines of #25255's (`SKILL.md` L276 and the ratchet's `triage-duties.md` row), so whichever lands second takes a trivial re-merge and re-measures `check:pm-skill-ratchet`. #25255's item 5 still points at the ruling thread this PR removes; its author re-points it after this lands.

## Verification

- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` ✓ (SKILL.md 319/319; director.md 70/70; triage-duties.md 120/120; every changed line ≤120 bytes)
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` ✓ · `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` ✓ · `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness` ✓
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the actual changed paths: 44 commands, run with exit codes recorded and reconciled with `--ran` — see the verification comment on this PR.
- `git grep -n -E '代裁|自裁|auto-adjudicated|裁决线程|有把握' -- .claude/skills` → only negations (⛔ 无代裁 …) and the three lane charters that already forbade it.

Governed surface `.claude/**` (Tier S): draft, awaiting the seat's `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review and the maintainer's word; ⛔ not to be flipped ready, queued or armed by this thread. `skip-changeset`: no published package is touched.
